newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria introduces new gas pricing system.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria introduces new gas pricing system.

text.p: Bulgaria's interim government decided on Monday to introduce a four percent retail surcharge for natural gas distributors in the country instead of pegging the gas price to the fuel oil price as before.

Interim Prime Minister Stefan Sofianski said the next step, which could be taken by the next government, would be either a total liberalisation of the gas price or increasing the percentage added to the price paid by the distributor.
Vassil Filipov, executive director of gas distribution monopoly Bulgargas, told reporters his company wanted a higher percentage.
"Our proposal was for a minimum of six percent as a lower surcharge would bring us financial losses," Filipov said.
Bulgaria, which lacks energy resources, imports natural gas from Russia only.
